title: HMGCLIP: Heterogeneous Multi-Granularity Contrastive Learning for E-commerce Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced general product understanding, they implicitly encode product information into global embeddings, thereby limiting their ability to capture fine-grained attributes. This limitation hinders performance in tasks requiring precise attribute discrimination, such as distinguishing subtle material differences among visually similar products. To address this challenge, we propose HMGCLIP, a unified multimodal embedding framework. By constructing a heterogeneous hypergraph, we leverage hypergraph topology to mine structure-aware hard negatives and align multi-granular semantics at both relation and hyperedge levels. This design enables a dual-granularity inference mechanism that dynamically fuses attribute evidence for both fine-grained and coarse-grained downstream tasks. translated_title: HMGCLIP：面向电子商务表示学习的异构多粒度对比学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：尽管近期多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）推进了通用产品理解，但它们将产品信息隐式编码为全局嵌入，从而限制了捕捉细粒度属性的能力。这一局限阻碍了需要精确属性区分的任务性能，例如区分视觉相似产品间细微的材质差异。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了HMGCLIP，一个统一的多模态嵌入框架。通过构建异构超图，我们利用超图拓扑挖掘结构感知的困难负样本，并在关系和超边层面对齐多粒度语义。该设计实现了一种双粒度推理机制，能够动态融合属性证据，以支持细粒度和粗粒度的下游任务。此外，我们发布了一个全面的细粒度电子商务数据集，以促进未来的基准测试。
tldr: 本文提出HMGCLIP框架，利用异构超图挖掘结构感知困难负样本并实现双粒度语义对齐，显著提升电子商务产品细粒度属性识别能力，同时发布了一个新的细粒度电商数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HMGCLIP, a unified multimodal embedding framework that leverages heterogeneous hypergraph topology to mine structure-aware hard negatives and align multi-granular semantics, enhancing fine-grained attribute discrimination for e-commerce tasks, along with a new fine-grained dataset release.
